_comment: The animated caption styles the editor offers (command-center/lib/captionStyles.ts CAPTION_STYLES) and what the export draws (modules/caption_styles.py STYLES, written as libass tags by modules/ass_captions.py). tests/test_caption_styles.py and command-center/tests/caption-styles.test.ts pin both copies to this file, and tests/test_caption_styles.py renders every style with the real export (ffmpeg + libass) when it is present. size_frac is the text height as a share of the frame's SHORT side; x/y/anchor are where the style's anchor sits; 'uses' are the tweaks the editor shows for it. word_spans are the rule both the export and the preview use to spread a cue's time over its words (weight = letters + 1, integer maths): the cue's words, its length in ms, and the [start, end] ms of each word. type_schedule are the typewriter's reveal runs: [first atom, ms into the cue] for a cue of that many atoms (letters, spaces, line breaks) and length. per_word_flags: which cues (by word count, in document order) are lit word by word given the per-cue cap and the whole-document word budget.
